instructions:
# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

## Hindi (hi)

Script: Devanagari. Used in UP, MP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Haryana, HP, Uttarakhand,
Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Delhi, and understood across the north.
Tone: everyday spoken Hindi (Hindustani). Avoid Sanskritised official words.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बैंक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन,
सर्टिफिकेट, डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: आवेदन करें (Apply), जमा करें (Submit), आगे (Next), पीछे (Back), खोजें (Search),
शेयर करें (Share), सेटिंग (Settings), भाषा (Language), मदद (Help).
Offices: तहसीलदार, पटवारी, ग्राम पंचायत, कलेक्टर, ब्लॉक विकास कार्यालय (BDO).
Gender: लिंग (never जाति). Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सितंबर.

## Gujarati (gu)

Script: Gujarati. Used in Gujarat, and spoken in Dadra & Nagar Haveli and
Daman & Diu.
Tone: everyday spoken Gujarati.
Words: ઓનલાઇન, ફોર્મ, પોર્ટલ, લૉગિન, આધાર, બેંક, મોબાઇલ, OTP, હેલ્પલાઇન, સર્ટિફિકેટ / દાખલો,
ડાઉનલોડ, અપલોડ.
UI: અરજી કરો, સબમિટ કરો, આગળ, પાછળ, શોધો, શેર કરો, સેટિંગ્સ, ભાષા, મદદ.
Offices: મામલતદાર, તલાટી, ગ્રામ પંચાયત, કલેક્ટર, તાલુકા પંચાયત.
Gender: જાતિ is caste; use લિંગ. Money: રૂ. 6,000; રૂ. 8 લાખ. September: સપ્ટેમ્બર.

## Marathi (mr)

Script: Devanagari. Used in Maharashtra, and widely in Goa.
Tone: everyday Marathi as spoken in Maharashtra.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बँक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन, दाखला / सर्टिफिकेट,
डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: अर्ज करा, सबमिट करा, पुढे, मागे, शोधा, शेअर करा, सेटिंग्ज, भाषा, मदत.
Offices: तहसीलदार, तलाठी, ग्रामपंचायत, जिल्हाधिकारी (कलेक्टर), आपले सरकार सेवा केंद्र.
Gender: लिंग. Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सप्टेंबर.

## Bengali (bn)

Script: Bengali. Used in West Bengal and Tripura, and in Assam's Barak Valley
and the Andamans.
Tone: everyday spoken Bengali (চলিত ভাষা), not সাধু ভাষা.
Words: অনলাইন, ফর্ম, পোর্টাল, লগইন, আধার, ব্যাংক, মোবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, সার্টিফিকেট,
ডাউনলোড, আপলোড.
UI: আবেদন করুন, জমা দিন, পরবর্তী, পিছনে, খুঁজুন, শেয়ার করুন, সেটিংস, ভাষা, সাহায্য.
Offices: বিডিও অফিস, গ্রাম পঞ্চায়েত, তহসিলদার, জেলাশাসক (কালেক্টর), দুয়ারে সরকার.

## Assamese (as)

Script: Bengali script with the Assamese letters ৰ and ৱ. Used in Assam.
This is Assamese, not Bengali. Use Assamese words and spellings: আঁচনি
(scheme), বেংক (bank), কৰক (do), নহয় (is not).
Words: অনলাইন, প্ৰপত্ৰ / ফৰ্ম, পৰ্টেল, লগইন, আধাৰ, বেংক, মবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, প্ৰমাণপত্ৰ,
ডাউনল'ড, আপল'ড.
UI: আবেদন কৰক, দাখিল কৰক, পৰৱৰ্তী, উভতি যাওক, বিচাৰক, শ্বেয়াৰ কৰক, ছেটিংছ, ভাষা, সহায়.
Offices: চক্ৰ বিষয়াৰ কাৰ্যালয় (Circle Office), গাঁও পঞ্চায়ত, উন্নয়ন খণ্ড কাৰ্যালয় (BDO),
জিলা উপায়ুক্ত.
Gender: লিংগ. Money: 6,000 টকা; 8 লাখ টকা. September: ছেপ্তেম্বৰ.

## Punjabi (pa)

Script: Gurmukhi. Used in Punjab and Chandigarh, and spoken in Delhi and

Tone: everyday spoken Punjabi.
Words: ਆਨਲਾਈਨ, ਫਾਰਮ, ਪੋਰਟਲ, ਲੌਗਇਨ, ਆਧਾਰ, ਬੈਂਕ, ਮੋਬਾਈਲ, OTP, ਹੈਲਪਲਾਈਨ, ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ,

## Odia (or)

Script: Odia. Used in Odisha.
Tone: everyday spoken Odia.
Words: ଅନଲାଇନ, ଫର୍ମ, ପୋର୍ଟାଲ, ଲଗଇନ, ଆଧାର, ବ୍ୟାଙ୍କ, ମୋବାଇଲ, OTP, ହେଲ୍ପଲାଇନ, ସାର୍ଟିଫିକେଟ,

items.t: Copy it from the ration card. If nothing is found, search again with your Aadhaar number.
Aadhaar of the family member whose card you are making now. Each member is done one at a time.
Use Aadhaar OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar; otherwise choose face authentication and scan the face on the phone camera.
Good light, face straight, no cap or dark glasses. A blurred photo gets the request rejected.
Where you actually live now, so the nearest empanelled hospitals are shown to you.
Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in (or the Ayushman app) and log in as Beneficiary with your mobile number and OTP.
Choose PMJAY and the state Jammu and Kashmir, then search for your family by ration card number or Aadhaar.
Find the member marked eKYC pending, verify with Aadhaar OTP or face authentication, and take the live photo.
Fill in the relation, district and PIN code and submit. The State Health Agency usually approves it within a day or two.
Log in again, open Download Card and save the Golden Card. If your family is not found, go to a CSC or the Ayushman Mitra desk of a SEHAT hospital with your ration card and Aadhaar.
At the hospital, show the card at the Ayushman Mitra desk and pay nothing for a covered treatment. If an empanelled hospital refuses, call 104.
104 — J&K health helpline, also for complaints when treatment is refused / 14555 or 1800-111-565 — Ayushman Bharat national helpline
Department of Social Welfare, Jammu & Kashmir

For a girl born on or after 1 April 2015 into a low-income family in Jammu & Kashmir, the government puts Rs.1,000 a month into an account in her name until she turns 14. The money then stays in a term deposit, and at 21 she receives about Rs.6.5 lakh for her studies or marriage. Parents apply online on JanSugam (also reached through e-UNNAT); the CDPO checks the application and the Deputy Commissioner sanctions it.
Rs.1,000 a month till she is 14; about Rs.6.5 lakh paid to her at 21
The girl was born on or after 1 April 2015
The parents' total income from all sources is below Rs.75,000 a year
The girl and her parents are residents of Jammu & Kashmir
The money is held in the girl's own account and paid to her only at age 21
Income certificate of the parents, showing less than Rs.75,000 a year
Aadhaar card of the girl and of the parents
Ration card or other address proof
J&K Bank account details in the girl's name, once the sanction letter asks for them
Exactly as written on her birth certificate.
Must be on or after 01/04/2015. Apply soon after the birth certificate is issued.
The hospital or place named on the birth certificate.
The 12 digits on the mother's or father's own Aadhaar card.
Total from all sources, the same figure as on the income certificate. It must be below Rs.75,000.
The block ICDS project where you live. Its CDPO checks your form.
Application updates and the sanction message come here by SMS.
Register on jansugam.jk.gov.in (or open it from e-UNNAT) with your mobile number, then log in.
Under Social Welfare, choose Application for obtaining Financial Assistance under Ladli Beti Scheme and fill in the girl's and parents' details.
Upload the birth, income and domicile certificates and the Aadhaar cards, submit, and note the application number from the SMS.
The CDPO checks the form within 15 days, then the District Programme Officer and the Deputy Commissioner take it up; the whole process is meant to finish within 45 days.
After sanction, open the girl's account at J&K Bank if the sanction letter asks, and add the account number on the portal.
Rs.1,000 is credited every month until she turns 14. At 21 the matured amount, about Rs.6.5 lakh, is paid to her.
0194-2479645 — Directorate of Social Welfare, Kashmir / your District Social Welfare Officer or CDPO (ICDS) office
Rural Development Department, Government of Jharkhand

Jharkhand's own rural housing scheme: Rs.2 lakh to build a pucca house with three rooms and a kitchen, for families who have no house or live in a kutcha house and did not get one under PM Awas Yojana-Gramin. The state received about 30 lakh applications at the 'Aapki Yojana, Aapki Sarkar, Aapke Dwar' camps, found about 20 lakh genuine, and is building houses for them in phases. The money comes in instalments into the beneficiary's bank account as each stage of the house is geo-tagged, plus 95 days of MGNREGA wages for the family's own labour.
Rs.2 lakh in instalments for a 3-room pucca house with kitchen, plus 95 days of MGNREGA wages
Rural families in Jharkhand with no house, or living in a kutcha or broken house
The family has never got a house under PMAY-G, Indira Awas, Birsa Awas or Baba Saheb Ambedkar Awas
Priority for PVTG families, families hit by natural disasters, and freed bonded labourers
Not for families with a serving or retired government employee, an income-tax or professional-tax payer, or a motorised four-wheeler or fishing boat
The family must be on the verified list made from the camp applications; each panchayat's list is shown at the Panchayat Bhawan
Bank passbook of an Aadhaar-linked account in the applicant's name
MGNREGA job card, for the 95 days of wages
Land paper for the plot where the house will be built (khatiyan or rent receipt)
Abua Awas Yojana portal, Rural Development Department

The 'Aapki Yojana, Aapki Sarkar, Aapke Dwar' camp in your panchayat when one is held, or the Panchayat Sachiv or the Block Development Officer (BDO) at the block office. Take Aadhaar, ration card, bank passbook, MGNREGA job card and land papers. If you already applied at a camp, check your name in the list at the Panchayat Bhawan, because houses are sanctioned from that list in order. There is no fee, so never pay a middleman who promises a house.
As on Aadhaar. The sanction and payments are in this name.
Husband's name if married, otherwise father's name.
Hesal, Hesal panchayat, Torpa block, Khunti district
Where the family lives and where the new house will be built.
Write SC, ST, OBC or General, and say if the family belongs to a PVTG group.
Kutcha, mud walls with tiled roof
Describe the house you live in now, or write 'no house'.
House received earlier under PMAY-G, Indira Awas or Birsa Awas?
Answer truthfully. Families who already got a government house are left out.
An Aadhaar-linked account in the applicant's own name. Every instalment comes here.
Needed for the 95 days of wages for building your own house.

If you applied at a camp, look for your name on the Abua Awas list at the Panchayat Bhawan. If you never applied, apply at the next 'Aapki Yojana, Aapki Sarkar, Aapke Dwar' camp or at the block office.
Panchayat and block staff visit to check that your house is kutcha and that the family never got a government house.
Selected families get a sanction letter, and the first instalment comes to the bank account.
Build the house in stages. At each stage the staff geo-tag a photo of it on the Abua Awas app, and the next instalment is released after that.
Work on your own house as MGNREGA labour and get up to 95 days of wages in your account; ask the Rozgar Sevak to open the work on your job card.
Finish the house with three rooms and a kitchen. The final geo-tag closes the case. For delays or demands for money, go to the Panchayat Sachiv or the BDO.
No dedicated helpline. Contact your Panchayat Sachiv or Rozgar Sevak, then the Block Development Officer (BDO) at the block office
Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Maiya Samman Yojana (Maiyan Samman)
Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand

Rs.2,500 a month for women aged 18 to 50 in Jharkhand, paid into their own Aadhaar-linked bank account by the 15th of every month. It started in August 2024 at Rs.1,000 and was raised to Rs.2,500 from December 2024. Applications are taken at camps held across the state; there is no online form to fill yourself. Women already getting the money must finish the physical verification (satyapan) and Aadhaar e-KYC, or the next instalments are held back.
Rs.2,500 a month (Rs.30,000 a year) into the woman's own bank account
Resident of Jharkhand, aged 18 or above and below 50 on the day of applying
Her family holds a yellow Antyodaya, pink Priority Household, white K-Oil or green state ration card
She has her own Aadhaar and a single bank account linked to Aadhaar

Not for a woman who, or whose husband (father, if she is unmarried), works for the central or state government, a PSU, local body or government-aided institution as regular, contract or honorarium staff, or draws a government pension
Not if a family member is a present or former MP or MLA, if the family pays income tax, or if she is an EPF member
Not if she already gets another social security pension from the department
Ration card of the family (yellow, pink, white or green)
Passbook of the Aadhaar-linked bank account in her own name
PAN card, if she has one (optional)
Signed self-declaration, which is part of the form

The Maiya Samman camp held in your panchayat or urban ward. The department takes applications through camps across Jharkhand, announced by the Anganwadi worker, Panchayat Sachiv and block office; between camps, ask at your Anganwadi centre or the block (Prakhand) or circle (Anchal) office. The form is free (the printed summary on the 2024 form still says Rs.1,000; the amount is now Rs.2,500). Go yourself, because your Aadhaar and photo are checked on the spot. Take the original Aadhaar, ration card, Aadhaar-linked bank passbook and voter ID, a colour photo and self-attested copies, and keep the acknowledgement.
Exactly as on Aadhaar. The money goes only to this woman.
पता (Village/mohalla, police station, panchayat/ward, block/circle, district)
Tetartoli, PS Kanke, Panchayat Sarwa, Block Kanke, District Ranchi
Your present address in Jharkhand, as on the ration card.
Her own 12-digit Aadhaar number, one digit per box.
Her own single account. A joint account or someone else's account will be rejected.
खाता आधार लिंक्ड है (Is the account linked to Aadhaar?)
Payment is made only to an Aadhaar-linked account. Get it linked at the bank before the camp.
Copy the bank name, branch and IFSC from the first page of the passbook.
Her name should be on this yellow, pink, white or green card.
She must be 18 or above and below 50. Use the date on Aadhaar.
Payment and verification messages come to this number.
Find out the date of the Maiya Samman camp in your panchayat or ward from the Anganwadi worker, Panchayat Sachiv or block office, and get the free form there (or print the official form).
Fill the form, tick that the account is Aadhaar-linked, paste the photo, sign the declaration and attach self-attested copies of Aadhaar, ration card, bank passbook and voter ID.
Go to the camp yourself. The operator enters the form on the portal and checks your Aadhaar and photo. Keep the acknowledgement.
Block and district officials verify the application. Once approved, Rs.2,500 arrives in your Aadhaar-linked account by the 15th of every month.
When the Anganwadi worker or block office calls you for satyapan or e-KYC, complete it. Names that are not verified do not get the next instalment.

1800-890-0215 — toll-free, Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Jharkhand
Directorate of Social Welfare, Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand

Money for girls in Jharkhand to stay in school and not be married off early: Rs.2,500 in Class 8, Rs.2,500 in Class 9, Rs.5,000 each in Classes 10, 11 and 12, and a one-time Rs.20,000 at age 18 to 19, Rs.40,000 in all. It goes to the first two daughters of a mother who study in government or government-aided schools. For school girls the school applies, by sending the girl's details from e-Vidya Vahini to the scheme portal. Others apply with the official form at the CDPO office.
Girls living in Jharkhand, enrolled in Class 8 to 12 in a government, government-aided, welfare-department or NCLP school
Only the first two daughters of a mother; the mother gives a self-declaration
Parents must not be permanent or retired central or state government or PSU employees, or draw a government pension or family pension

For the Rs.20,000 grant she must be 18 or 19 years old when applying, and a voter ID is needed
Aadhaar card of the mother (of the father, if the mother has died)
Bank or post office passbook in the girl's name
Mother's self-declaration on birth order, and the parents' self-declaration that they are not taxpayers or government employees

Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana portal

Barwadih, Barwadih panchayat, Chas block, Bokaro district

Attach a copy of the birth certificate. For the 18–19 grant, also give the voter ID number.
Only the first or second daughter can apply. The mother signs a declaration on this.
The girl's own 12-digit Aadhaar number.

At the start of the school year, tell the class teacher that she wants the Savitribai benefit, and give copies of her Aadhaar, the mother's Aadhaar, the birth certificate, the bank passbook and the ration card.
The school sends her details from e-Vidya Vahini to the Savitribai portal, adds the Aadhaar, bank account and declarations, and forwards the application to the CDPO.

For the Rs.20,000 grant at 18 or 19 after leaving school, fill the official form, attach the self-declarations and voter ID, and submit it at the CDPO office or through the Anganwadi worker. Keep the receipt.
The CDPO checks the application and the District Social Welfare Officer approves it. Wrong details are sent back to the school for correction.
The money for that class comes by DBT into the girl's account. Check the status on savitribaipksy.jharkhand.gov.in under Track Beneficiary Status.
Repeat every year from Class 8 to Class 12, then apply for the Rs.20,000 grant at age 18 or 19.

Ayushman Bharat – Arogya Karnataka (AB-ArK Health Card)
Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Karnataka — Suvarna Arogya Suraksha Trust (SAST)

Karnataka's health cover, run together with the central Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. Families with a BPL (Priority Household or Antyodaya) ration card get free treatment up to Rs.5 lakh a year for the whole family; other families get 30% of the treatment cost paid, up to Rs.1.5 lakh a year. Treatment starts at a government hospital, which refers you to a listed private hospital if it cannot treat you; listed emergencies can go straight to a listed hospital. The card is made at a government hospital counter for Rs.10 with your Aadhaar and ration card.
BPL families: up to Rs.5 lakh a year free; other families: 30% of the cost, up to Rs.1.5 lakh a year
Every resident of Karnataka with an Aadhaar card can enrol
Eligible category (free treatment up to Rs.5 lakh per family per year): families with a Priority Household (BPL) or Antyodaya ration card under the Food Security Act
General category (APL card or no ration card): the government pays 30% of the package rate, up to Rs.1.5 lakh per family per year, and the family pays the rest
Simpler treatments are given only in government hospitals. A private hospital needs a referral from a government hospital, except for the listed emergencies
Aadhaar authentication is compulsory before a referral to a private hospital
Aadhaar card of the patient (each member of the family enrols separately)
Ration card, which decides whether you are in the eligible or the general category
